title: Three Seals, Immortal Mansion
summary: Qi Qi (Qi Huoshui), princess of the Southern Ridge Demon Emperor Palace, attacks Ye Fan for eating her dragon horse and traps him in her '3,000 Small Worlds' art. Ye Fan burns his way out with spiritual force, then overpowers her in his own spiritual space. She threatens him with her brother the Southern Demon, and to be let go she leads him to a newly found immortal mansion full of dragon marrow. Ye Fan leaves her tied up at the entrance and goes in alone. Inside, the mansion's spirit beasts, including an ancient giant snake and a Thunder King bird, are going berserk because three seals that kept them calm have been stolen. Ye Fan finds Ji Haoyue and Ji Ziyue ambushed by a group and a hidden archer. He kills the archer and takes the Three Seals (Human King, Heaven Overturning, Mountain Embracing) and the Wanshang Bow. He then beats Yan Yunluan, who claims both treasures, drawing the bow more often than Yan thought possible. Ji Haoyue gives him dragon marrow, and Ji Ziyue sees through his disguise.
